```{r data generation, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
AB = sample(1:9,2)*sample(c(-1,1),2,T)
A = AB[1]
B = AB[2]
ex1 = paste0("\\sqrt[3]{x+",A,"}+",B)
ex1 = gsub("+-","-",ex1,fixed=T)
ex2 = paste0("(x+",-B,")^3+",-A)
ex2 = gsub("+-","-",ex2,fixed=T)

inv1 = paste0("x=\\sqrt[3]{y+",A,"}+",B)
inv1 = gsub("+-","-",inv1,fixed=T)

inv2 = paste0("x+",-B,"=\\sqrt[3]{y+",A,"}")
inv2 = gsub("+-","-",inv2,fixed=T)

inv3 = paste0("(x+",-B,")^3=y+",A)
inv3 = gsub("+-","-",inv3,fixed=T)

inv4 = paste0("(x+",-B,")^3+",-A,"=y")
inv4 = gsub("+-","-",inv4,fixed=T)

ach = gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",-B,")^3+",-A),fixed=T)
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",-B,")^3+",A),fixed=T))
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",B,")^3+",-A),fixed=T))
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",B,")^3+",A),fixed=T))
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",-A,")^3+",-B),fixed=T))
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",A,")^3+",-B),fixed=T))
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",-A,")^3+",B),fixed=T))
ach = c(ach,gsub("+-","-",paste0("(x+",A,")^3+",B),fixed=T))

ach = sort(ach)

al = paste0("* $f^{-1}(x)=",ach,"$",collapse="\n")

sol = paste0(1*(ach==ex2),collapse="")

```

Question
========

Let a transformed cube-root function be defined by the equation below:

$$f(x) = `r ex1`$$

Find the inverse function.

Answerlist
--------

`r al`



Solution
========

First, get rid of function notation.


$$y = `r ex1`$$

Swap $x$ and $y$ to find an inverse function.

$$`r inv1`$$

Solve for $y$ by undoing the operation on the right side.

$$`r inv2`$$

$$`r inv3`$$

$$`r inv4`$$

The correct answer is $f^{-1}(x)=`r ex2`$.
